purpose: Tail-risk and reward/risk guard after Candidate D reduced trade count but failed PF and drawdown gates on 1Y.
professional_adjustment_notes: Candidate C produced positive 1Y return but unacceptable drawdown and near-flat PF.
Candidate D reduced trade count and drawdown, but PF remained below the 1.15 gate.
Candidate E does not only tighten entries; it changes payoff structure by reducing ATR stop distance and increasing ATR take-profit distance.
Fixed money risk is lowered to reduce equity damage from tail losses while preserving enough trade count for statistical meaning.
Daily and per-trade time guards are tightened to reduce long weak trades and clustered losses.
